projects.title: The Man Who Was the Shadow
projects.text: A bronze-toned figure whose head is a lamp: he lights the street for others while his own face stays in shadow.

projects.title: The Deafening Silence
projects.credit: Concept & artistic direction: Miranda Kuprava · Original inspiration: Melita Iosava’s drawing Freedom
projects.text: Dedicated to the children affected by the war in Ukraine. Child-sized, faceless figures stand within a field of light, each holding a balloon. Made from unpainted fiberglass, all visible colour is created by light. The installation unfolds in three acts: everyday city life, the sudden interruption of an air-raid siren, and finally silence accompanied by Mahler’s Kindertotenlieder.

projects.title: Merani
projects.kicker: Independent conceptual proposal · inspired by Ferrari design
projects.text: Born from the meeting of Ferrari design and Nikoloz Baratashvili’s poem “Merani”, where the horse becomes an image of freedom, sacrifice and the courage to open an untrodden path. Original concept and hand-sculpted model by Miranda Kuprava.

projects.title: Space Age
projects.text: A kinetic sculpture inspired by the visual memory of the 1960s Space Age. Independently moving rings orbit a luminous central structure; in Christmas mode the whole work becomes a celebration of light.

projects.title: From One Root, Every Future
projects.kicker: Independent conceptual proposal for XPENG · kinetic tree
projects.text: The tree is not decoration. It is a spatial metaphor of evolution: root as origin and energy, central spine as intelligence, spiral roads as mobility, orbital nodes as transition, and the upper air-space as the point where movement becomes three-dimensional. Road → intelligence → physical AI → flight.

projects.title: Automotive Tree
projects.kicker: Independent conceptual proposal · technological sculptural tree
projects.text: A sculptural tree conceived as a dialogue between automotive engineering and seasonal ritual, designed for showroom and atrium scale.

projects.title: Wine & Art · Vitis Vinifera
projects.kicker: Collectible art & lighting for wine estates, châteaux and wineries
projects.text: A singular sculptural object built around an old grapevine, the central and irreplaceable element of the work. Functional art and site-specific design for European wine estates.

projects.title: Sculpting a Child’s Imagination
projects.text: The adult author does not “correct” the child’s figures: proportion, movement, strange form and colour remain untouched. That raw precision is the work’s main value.

projects.title: Balenciaga Paper Lights
projects.text: Sculptural lighting objects created from original Balenciaga paper. The material is neither painted nor recolored; its existing graphic language becomes part of the artwork.

projects.title: Merani
projects.kicker: Independent conceptual proposal · Ferrari × Georgian Romanticism
projects.text: Every great design begins with an emotion. An original concept and hand-sculpted model uniting the language of Ferrari design with the Georgian poem “Merani”.

projects.title: Wendy's / China
projects.kicker: Independent conceptual proposal · from packaging to papier-mâché
projects.text: Ecological, educational and functional art: used Wendy's paper is collected, transformed into papier-mâché and returned to the restaurants as tables, lamps and public art.

projects.title: Drawings made real
projects.credit: Ideas and drawings: Melita Iosava · Artworks: Miranda Kuprava

projects.title: Also with Melita
projects.kicker: Projects that began with Melita’s drawings
projects.text: Children's Park of Imagination (Shanghai) and Pinocchios' Library (New York) began with Melita’s drawings, alongside the Tsinandali exhibition in Spaces & Worlds and The Deafening Silence, which grew from her drawing Freedom.
